env -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONUSERBASE -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 benchmarks/work/native_factorial_review_py310_20261004/bin/python -I -S -B -c 'import csv,hashlib,json,math; from pathlib import Path; b=Path("benchmark_tools/results"); d=b/"controlled_fragment_integration_20261009_v1"; manifest=json.loads((d/"manifest.json").read_text()); raw=json.loads((b/"controlled_fragment_results_20261009_v1/report.json").read_text()); revised=Path(manifest["manuscript"]["path"]).read_text(); parent=Path(manifest["inputs"]["parent"]["path"]).read_text(); restored=revised
for name in ("methods","results","limitations"): restored=restored.replace((d/(name+"_section.md")).read_text(),"",1)
assert restored==parent
for ref in [*manifest["inputs"].values(),*manifest["outputs"],manifest["source"],manifest["manuscript"]]:
 p=Path(ref["path"]); payload=p.read_bytes(); assert len(payload)==ref["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"]
methods=("orthohmm_high_sensitivity","orthohmm_satellite_v2","orthofinder_full","orthofinder_sequence_only"); labels=dict(zip(methods,("HS","PHY","OF","OF checkpoint"))); summaries={(r["arm"],r["method"]):r for r in raw["metric_means"]}; rows={(r["arm"],r["seed"],r["method"]):r for r in raw["records"]}; seeds=range(20261101,20261111); text=(d/"results_section.md").read_text(); numeric_cells=0
with (d/"means.tsv").open() as f: means=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
assert len(means)==4
for method,row in zip(methods,means):
 values=[summaries["baseline",method]["metrics"]["f1"]["mean"]]+[summaries["fragment",method]["metrics"][m]["mean"] for m in ("f1","precision","recall")]+[sum(rows["fragment",s,method]["score"]["pair_endpoint_coverage"] for s in seeds)/10]; fields=("baseline_f1","fragment_f1","fragment_precision","fragment_recall","fragment_pair_endpoint_coverage")
 assert row["method"]==method and row["eligible_seeds"]=="10" and all(float(row[k])==v for k,v in zip(fields,values)); assert "| "+" | ".join([labels[method]]+[format(100*v,".4f") for v in values])+" |" in text; numeric_cells+=5
with (d/"comparisons.tsv").open() as f: differences=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
assert len(differences)==15
for observed,expected in zip(differences,raw["comparisons"]):
 assert all(observed[k]==expected[k] for k in ("target_arm","target_method","reference_arm","reference_method","metric")); assert float(observed["estimate"])==expected["estimate"] and observed["eligible_seeds"]=="10"; comparison=labels[expected["target_method"]]+(" F-B" if expected["reference_arm"]=="baseline" else "-OF F-F"); cells=[comparison,expected["metric"],format(100*expected["estimate"],"+.4f")]
 for kind in ("nominal","adjusted"):
  interval=expected[kind+"_interval"]; assert [float(observed[kind+"_low"]),float(observed[kind+"_high"])]==interval; cells.append("["+format(100*interval[0],"+.4f")+", "+format(100*interval[1],"+.4f")+"]")
 assert "| "+" | ".join(cells+["10"])+" |" in text; numeric_cells+=5
with (d/"endpoint_counts.tsv").open() as f: counts=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
assert len(counts)==12
for observed,(method,n) in zip(counts,((m,n) for m in methods for n in range(3))):
 assert observed["method"]==method and int(observed["fragment_endpoints"])==n; cells=[labels[method],str(n)]
 for arm in ("baseline","fragment"):
  values=[sum(rows[arm,s,method]["strata"][n]["score"][k] for s in seeds) for k in ("tp","fp","fn")]; assert all(int(observed[arm+"_"+k])==v for k,v in zip(("tp","fp","fn"),values)); cells.append(" / ".join(str(v) for v in values))
 assert "| "+" | ".join(cells)+" |" in text; numeric_cells+=6
assert numeric_cells==167 and manifest["publication_ready"] is False and manifest["new_bootstrap_draws"]==0
print(json.dumps(dict(status="independent_fragment_integration_readback_verified",mean_rows=4,comparison_rows=15,endpoint_count_rows=12,numeric_cells=167,parent_byte_restoration=True,manuscript_sha256=manifest["manuscript"]["sha256"],publication_ready=False),sort_keys=True))'
